question.prompt: If the sum of all the angles except one of a convex polygon is \(2190^\circ,\) then the number of sides of the polygon must be

solutions.explanation:
The missing angle is an interior angle of a convex polygon, so its measure \(\alpha\) satisfies \(0^\circ<\alpha<180^\circ\). If the polygon has \(n\) sides, its complete interior-angle sum is \(180(n-2)^\circ\). Consequently,
\[
2190<180(n-2)<2370.
\]
The complete sum must be a multiple of \(180\). The nearby multiples are \(2160\), \(2340\), and \(2520\), so only \(2340\) lies in the required interval. Hence
\[
n-2=\frac{2340}{180}=13,
\qquad n=15.
\]
The omitted angle is \(2340^\circ-2190^\circ=150^\circ\), which satisfies the convexity restriction. The answer is \(\boxed{15}\), choice B.
